mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, u.profile_image AS userProfileImage, c.content AS content, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM project_post_comment c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
